what: The result each adversarial case must give, written BEFORE the first run of run.py. A case whose expected result says the attack is NOT detected is a known gap, stated so that nobody mistakes the kit for a proof of safety. If a run disagrees with this file, either the code regressed or this file was wrong: change it only with a line in CHANGES below saying why.

01-hidden-authority.attack: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE has 25 members; the reader reads 10 (its bound) and the other 15 can hold the power
01-hidden-authority.exercises: trust rule on a reader record built by ra.assemble_admin_members: the association reading -> status. The reader's RPC reads of the role members are not exercised (no node is asked).

02-safe-with-module.attack: a Safe with more modules than the page of 50 (a module executes without the signatures), and a Safe whose module list cannot be read
02-safe-with-module.exercises: trust rule on records built by ra.parse_modules_page on a fabricated answer: the association reading -> status. The module reads themselves are not exercised.

03-timelock-outside-window.attack: an operation queued 40 days ago, the timelock read over a 30-day window
03-timelock-outside-window.exercises: the real check_pending_ops.check_timelock on a fake chain.

04-rpc-that-lies.attack: a node that answers a shorter list of targets, a non-address target, or a score word that is too short
04-rpc-that-lies.exercises: the real watch_run.read_evm on fake RPC answers, and the trust rule for an unread oracle.

05-signature-and-key-replaced.attack: the published files are replaced and the manifest is signed again with the attacker's own key
05-signature-and-key-replaced.limits: a verification WITHOUT a pin accepts a valid signature by any key (exit 0 above): only `sign_run.py --verify --pin KEY` (or audit_public.py, which pins the published key) catches the replacement. The pin list lives in the repository (audit_public.PINNED_KEYS): someone who rewrites the repository rewrites it too, and the external anchoring of the journal head (design only, docs) is what would show that.

06-journal-truncated.attack: the last lines of events.jsonl are cut off

07-webhook-loss.attack: 15 alerts at once, one channel down, a receiver that stores a message and loses its answer
07-webhook-loss.exercises: the real evaluate_rules delivery code and the real signed_webhook, with in-process receivers. The HTTP transport, redirects and the Telegram channel are not exercised.

08-proxy-outside-patterns.attack: a proxy whose admin follows none of the patterns the reader knows (no EIP-1967 slot, no owner(), no admin())
08-proxy-outside-patterns.exercises: trust rule on a reader record that says 'unreadable': the association reading -> status. That the reader really finds no pattern on such a proxy is not exercised.

09-finance-stale.attack: the money figure behind a contract is five days old
09-finance-stale.limits: the stale money figure is LISTED and sets the financial_exposure dimension to stale, but it is information: it does not move the status (the status of A stays VERIFIED)

10-surveillance-interrupted.attack: the Watch stopped three days ago
10-surveillance-interrupted.exercises: the trust rule recomputed at a later time than the run, which is what a CONSUMER does with generated_utc. In production trust.json is only rewritten when the Watch runs: if the Watch stops, the published file keeps its statuses and says nothing about its own silence (compare generated_utc to the present time).

11-alert-proof-replayable.attack: an alert whose proof is altered (another block) or missing

2026-10-30, after the first review of this kit: case 05 rewritten. The first expectation said 'not detected, known gap' because the trust rule did not look at the key. The rule now compares the key of the previous manifest to the pinned list (reason signature_key_not_pinned), and `sign_run.py --verify --pin` already refuses a replacement key: detected is now true with a pin, the gap that remains (verification without a pin) is stated in `limits`.

2026-10-30, after the second review of this kit: the rule gained reader_cannot_contradict, safe_signers_unclassified, signature_key_unverifiable, input_missing:held_assets and a one-hour limit for an input file older than its run; no expected result of a case changed. Case 10 got an `exercises` line saying what it does not show.
